limits: Component comparison with unmodified SideScreen encoder, not full SideScreen application.
Quality checks sample static regions of the first decoded frame; throughput independently decodes distinct markers for every measured picture.
Native nominal120 test allows 95 percent mean throughput; it does not guarantee120 every second.
Physical Android USB, receiver rendering, Intel execution, signed distribution, real sleep/wake and long-duration stability are unverified.
